device_entry.description: 用于实验自动化中的非物理软件组件，负责组织EPICS步进扫描流程。它可配置位置器、探测器、触发器、计数器和额外PV，执行逐点扫描、采集数据、处理暂停/中止、发布每点数据并写出扫描文件。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical software component for experiment automation that orchestrates EPICS step-scan workflows. It configures positioners, detectors, triggers, counters, and extra PVs, then executes point-by-point scans, acquires data, handles pause/abort logic, publishes per-point data, and writes scan output files.
